title: Comedy material and his own act
summary: Jones says he usually did his own act, including Russian dancing, clog and singing his own numbers.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Today, the comedians often buy an act that's all set up for them. In your day, did you have to work out your own material, or did you work from a script that somebody else would write up?

Sometimes. Sometimes, if a fella had something he wanted you to pull over his way, you tried his way. But as a rule, when I hired a man with his show, I had my own act. Yeah. See, I had my own act. See, I'm a Russian dancer. I do Russian dancing. I do wings. I do rhythm. I do clog. And I sings. My own numbers.
